description: Hand-editable region/theme config for the Asymmetry Hunter GDELT-pulse component (h). For each region we query the free GDELT 2.0 DOC API (article volume + average tone); Welford running stats turn the latest reading into a volume z-score (spike) and we require negative tone for a geopolitical-stress anomaly. 'asset_map' is the STATIC mapping from an anomalous region to the affected assets and their stance under stress (long = benefits from the stress, short = hurt). Only assets present in both this map and the Hunter's ASSET_SPECS receive a vote; everything else stays neutral (no view).

MIDDLE_EAST.query: (Iran OR Israel OR Gaza OR Hormuz OR "Middle East")

EUROPE.query: (Ukraine OR Russia OR NATO OR "European Union")

LATAM.query: (Venezuela OR "Latin America") (crisis OR sanctions OR military)
